subject: Zenline POC: hands-on session scheduling + recap
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@zenline.com>, Sana Reddy <sana@zenline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Zenline POC: hands-on session scheduling + recap

Hi Alex / Sana,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to get the hands-on POC kicked off. We want to run a focused 90-minute working session that covers:

- Prompt review and test prompts for your top-5 flows
- Routing configuration (latency vs cost policies) and a short validation
- A quick load smoke test (5–10 minutes) to validate throughput on the Happy Path

Proposed times (PT):
- Mon May 24, 10:00–11:30
- Tue May 25, 09:00–10:30

Attached is a brief agenda and a short pre-req checklist (agenda-zenline-poc.pdf). Karthik will lead the hands-on part; Marissa will take notes and capture action items. If either of those slots works, I’ll send a calendar invite and share the test dataset/drive folder ahead of time.

Pre-reqs (one-liners):
- Provide a sample prompt set (or we can use the quick starter prompts included in the Drive link)
- Confirm the test endpoint IP allowlist or VPC peering details if the load test will originate from your infra

Any constraints on the schedule or other attendees we should add?

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: agenda-zenline-poc.pdf

From: Alex Park <alex.park@zenline.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Reddy <sana@zenline.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Zenline POC: hands-on session scheduling + recap

Hey Vivek — thanks for the clear agenda. Tue/May 25 at 09:00 PT would work better for our engineering folks.

One ask: our infra lead (Rahul Verma, rahul.verma@zenline.com) may want to join for the load test only — is that OK?

Also, can we push the start by 15 minutes to 09:15 PT so our morning standup finishes? If that’s possible, please send the calendar invite and any short notes on the CSV format you’ll use for the load run.

Thanks,
Alex

Subject: Re: Zenline POC: hands-on session scheduling + recap

Perfect — thanks Alex. Tue May 25, 09:15–10:45 PT is confirmed. I’ve created the calendar event and shared the Drive with a short test prompt pack and the load-test template.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=zenline-poc-20270523
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/zenline-docs
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/ZEN-1342

Notes for the session:
- Karthik will walk through routing policies (10 min), then we’ll do the prompt review (30 min), hands-on routing changes + verification (25 min), followed by the 10-min load smoke test.
- If Rahul wants to join only for the load test, that’s fine — we’ll make that segment self-contained.

Attachments included in the calendar invite: agenda-zenline-poc.pdf, session-quickstart.txt

Marissa — can you capture action items and share a short recap with owners and ETA after the session?

Thanks all,
Vivek
Attachments: session-quickstart.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@zenline.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Zenline POC — session notes, load test results, and action items (recap)

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks for a productive hands-on session this morning. Quick recap and owners below. Attached: pv-routing-loadtests-20270523.csv (summary of the 10-minute smoke test) and a link to the session recording (session-recording-link.txt).

Summary (high level):
- Prompt review: validated top-5 prompts, two prompts required minor edits to discourage verbosity — suggestions included in the Drive doc.
- Routing: implemented a cost-fallback policy and a low-latency route for the checkout flow. Latency improved ~18% on the Happy Path samples during the smoke test.
- Load smoke test: 10-minute run at ~60 r/s target. No errors above 500ms; median latency ~210ms. See CSV for full metrics.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Alex: Share the sanitized training snippet (for rerank tuning) — due 2027-05-28
- Karthik: Produce a short runbook for how to toggle routing policies in prod — due 2027-06-02
- Marissa: Upload annotated prompt edits and the session recording to the Drive + create a short eval checklist — due 2027-05-25
- Vivek: Draft mutual action plan with proposed dates for next deep-dive (A/B test and longer throughput run) — due 2027-05-24

Next session proposal: 2027-06-02 11:00–12:30 PT (A/B test configuration + extended throughput run). Please confirm availability and any additional attendees (data/infra) you want included.

Attachments: pv-routing-loadtests-20270523.csv, session-recording-link.txt

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Park <alex.park@zenline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Zenline POC — session notes, load test results, and action items (recap)

Thanks Marissa — great notes and appreciate the CSV. Confirming: Rahul will send the sanitized snippet by 5/28. The June 2nd slot works for our team; I’ll loop in Data Lead (Priya Shah) to join the A/B configuration discussion.

We’ll also surface a short list of success criteria (latency targets + acceptable delta in quality) before the next session.

Thanks,
Alex
